verses.1: And Etalya, mother of Ahaziah, saw that her son had died. She mourned greatly and destroyed all the crops in her field.
verses.2: And Jehosheba, the daughter of the king Yoram, took Ahaziah, the son of Ahazia, from among the dead bodies of the king’s sons. She stole him away from them. They hid him in a secret place, so that Atalia wouldn’t find him. And he didn’t die.
verses.3: And she became the house of Jehovah, hidden for six years. And Atalia ruled over the earth.
verses.4: And in the seventh year, Jehovah sent and took away the sheep of the flock for sacrifice. He brought them before the house of Jehovah. He made a covenant with them, and honored them in the house of Jehovah. He also saw them as the children of the king.
verses.5: And he commanded, “This is what you must do during the Sabbath days. You must also keep the laws related to the protection of the king’s house.”
verses.6: And the third one was at the door of Sur, and the third one was at the door next to Harazim. They kept guard over the house from inside.
verses.7: And with both hands, all those who are from the Sabbath should carry out the duties of keeping the commandments of Jehovah. They must also take care of the affairs of the house of God.
verses.8: And they surrounded the king, with everyone in their hands. They brought him to the scribes. May death be upon him! May he be destroyed both when he left and when he returned.
verses.9: And the priests did as Yahweh commanded them. The priest took one man from among the people on the day of Pentecost, along with those who were going out on that day. They went to the priest.
verses.10: And the priest gave to the musicians the instruments and the rulers that belonged to King David, who was in the house of Jehovah.
verses.11: And the priests stood there, each with his staff in hand, from the southern courtyard all the way to the northern courtyard, around the king.
verses.12: And he brought out the king’s son, and gave him the reward and honor. Then he made him king. He killed him, and they said, “Long live the king!”
verses.13: And Atalia heard the voices of the people. So she entered the house of Jehovah.
verses.14: And behold, the king stood on his throne, along with the officials and the rulers. All the people of the land rejoiced and sang in the courts. At that moment, Etela torn her clothes apart and cried out loudly.
verses.15: And the priest commanded the singers to bring her out into the courtyard where the women would sing. But her husband died in Haro’im. For the priest said, “Do not let the house of Jehovah be empty.”
verses.16: And they placed their hands upon her. Then, the entrance to the palace of the king was opened. And she died there.
verses.17: And Jehovah will establish the covenant between Jehovah and the king, and between the people. It shall be a covenant that will serve as a bond between Jehovah and the people.
verses.18: And all the people of the land came into the house of the priest. They destroyed his idols and his statues. The priest was killed before the idols were destroyed. Then the priest put seals on the house of Jehovah.
verses.19: And he took the priests, the Levites, and all the people of the land. He removed the king from the house of God. Then they entered through the gate of the Levites, into the king’s palace, and sat on the throne of kings.
verses.20: And all the people of the land rejoiced. The city was peaceful. And Etalya was killed in the palace of the king.
